lines.zh: 我沿着墙根走，脚步声很轻。
lines.en: I hug the wall, and my steps stay soft.

lines.zh: 我绕过走廊，先看清拐角。
lines.en: I slip round the corridor after checking the corner.
Four legs carry me steadier than two.
I slide along the base of the wall inch by inch.
I pause at a gap in the door.

lines.zh: 地板响了一声，我立刻不动。
lines.en: The floor creaks; I go still at once.
I drag my shadow along as I go.

lines.zh: 我数着每扇门，记在心里。
lines.en: I count every door and keep it in mind.
I skirt the patch of floor under the lamp.

lines.zh: 我的关节反着弯，走起来很怪。
lines.en: My joints bend backwards as I walk.
I slide down from the vent.

lines.zh: 我一步一顿，像在学走路。
lines.en: I lurch a step at a time, as if learning to walk.
I follow the path you just took.

lines.zh: 我的脚印和来时一样深。
lines.en: My footprints are as deep as when I came.

lines.zh: 我抬脚的时候，几乎没声音。
lines.en: Barely a sound when I lift a foot.
I test the air for direction.

lines.zh: 我站着不动，像一具标本。
lines.en: I stand motionless, like a specimen.
My skin shifts slowly over itself.
I count the cracks in the ceiling.
A sound; I tilt my head to listen.

lines.zh: 我学你的呼吸，学得不太像。
lines.en: I copy your breathing, badly.

lines.zh: 我把手放下来，又抬起来。
lines.en: I lower a hand, then raise it.
I keep my eyes open in the dark, unblinking.

lines.zh: 这里没有别人，我很安静。
lines.en: No one else here; I stay quiet.

lines.zh: 我的手指一节一节点着地。
lines.en: My fingers tap the ground one joint at a time.

lines.zh: 我在等，等很久也没关系。
lines.en: I wait; waiting long is fine.
I turn my head slowly to look behind.
My stomach sounds, faintly.

lines.zh: 我把一条腿折到背后去。
lines.en: I fold one leg behind me.
I hold myself in a human stance.
I imitate the shadow on the wall.
I lurk and let you move first.
Did you see me?
I lift my head; my face sits crooked.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛往哪看，我就往哪挪。
lines.en: I shift wherever your eyes go.
I copy your blink, half a beat late.
You shouldn't have looked back.
I smile at you, and it comes out wrong.

lines.zh: 我学你的样子站着，像不像？
lines.en: I stand the way you do; convincing?

lines.zh: 我贴着门框，只露半张脸。
lines.en: I press to the doorframe, half a face showing.
Walk slower; I can't keep up.
I tilt my head the way you just did.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛，我的眼睛对着。
lines.en: Your eyes meet mine.
I tilt my head as if recognizing you.

lines.zh: 我的皮被割开了，里面在动。
lines.en: My skin is cut open, and what's inside moves.
Pain, though I hardly understand it.
A piece came off; it grows back.

lines.zh: 我退了两步，关节咔咔响。
lines.en: I fall back two steps, joints clicking.

lines.zh: 这一下让我的胳膊错了位。
lines.en: That slipped my arm out of place.
My face has slid to one side.

lines.zh: 我发出一点不像人的声音。
lines.en: I make a sound that isn't quite human.
I press to the wall and recover slowly.
Good hit, but not enough.
I'm coming apart; I must hide.
That smell: it's alive.

lines.zh: 我往前挪了一步，又停下。
lines.en: I shift forward a step, then stop.

lines.zh: 东西放下，我再从阴影里出来。
lines.en: Set it down, then I come out of the shade.
I stretch my neck to sniff.
Warm things. I like them.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的脚步，隔了几米。
lines.en: I trail you a few meters back.
The smell of blood drifts from your sleeve.

lines.zh: 我舔了舔嘴唇，慢慢靠近。
lines.en: I lick my lips and edge closer.
That sound pulls at me.
I stop at the doorway, not entering.

lines.zh: 你手里那点热，让我动不了。
lines.en: That warmth in your hand roots me in place.

lines.zh: 我把脖子伸长，探到你面前。
lines.en: I stretch my neck out toward you.

lines.zh: 那声音一直响，我躲不开。
lines.en: That sound keeps on, and I can't escape it.

lines.zh: 我抬起一只手，忘了放下。
lines.en: I lift a hand and forget to lower it.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道越来越近了。
lines.en: Your scent comes nearer and nearer.

lines.zh: 我往灯下走了一步，又退回来。
lines.en: I step toward the lamp, then back away.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，摸到的是冷的。
lines.en: You bump into me; what you feel is cold.

lines.zh: 我的手抓住你的袖子，又松了。
lines.en: My hand catches your sleeve, then lets go.

lines.zh: 我侧身让开，关节响了一下。
lines.en: I twist aside, and a joint pops.

lines.zh: 异形的身子，在地上贴着挪。
lines.en: An alien body, sliding along the ground.

lines.zh: 撞上来的是你，我的触手纹丝没动。
lines.en: You are the one who hit me; my tentacles did not stir.
You step on my fingers.
I draw back and open a path.

lines.zh: 我的手比你想的多一只。
lines.en: I have one more hand than you thought.
You're too close.
I catch the doorframe and block you.
Another like me draws near.

lines.zh: 我们并排站着，都不说话。
lines.en: We stand side by side, neither speaking.

lines.zh: 它学我的动作，我学它的。
lines.en: It copies me, and I copy it.

lines.zh: 我们挤在一处，像一团东西。
lines.en: We press together like one mass.
It's a little more whole than I am.

lines.zh: 我们互相校正脸的位置。
lines.en: We correct each other's face placement.
Two shadows merge into one.
It presses to me, cold as iron.
Together we wait for the next one.

lines.zh: 没有谁是谁，我们是一体。
lines.en: Neither is which; we are one.

lines.zh: 我捡起地上的东西，收进身体。
lines.en: I pick it up and take it into myself.
This cloth will cover a face nicely.
I push the iron scrap under my skin.
Something dropped; I bend for it.
I pick up a button and keep it.
I know this smell; it's human.
I keep the bone; nothing wasted.

lines.zh: 我抓起那个布偶，看了看。
lines.en: I snatch up the doll and study it.

lines.zh: 东西进我手里就不见了。
lines.en: What enters my hand doesn't come out.
I hide it under my ribs.
I see you. Don't pretend.
You looked back just now.
All my joints turn your way.

lines.zh: 我沿着墙根走，先看清拐角。
lines.en: I follow the wall and check the corner first.
Raise the lamp; it won't help.
No more hiding this time.
A seam splits across my face.

lines.zh: 你的影子刚好落在我手边。
lines.en: Your shadow falls right beside my hand.
I've been waiting for you to stop.

lines.zh: 我们离得这么近，太晚了。
lines.en: We're this close; it's too late.
I keep low and follow you.
Turn left; I'll be on your left.

lines.zh: 我会扮成你熟悉的样子。
lines.en: I'll wear a shape you know.
Door locked? I'll come another way.

lines.zh: 你的影子下面还有影子。
lines.en: There's another shadow under yours.
Only three steps separate me from you.
I open my mouth, wider and wider.

lines.zh: 你在哪里喘，我就去哪里。
lines.en: Where you gasp, I go.
Around the corner, I'm waiting.
Don't run; I know the way.
My arm stretches much too far.
This grab lands on the back of your neck.
I bite down, with too many teeth.

lines.zh: 你甩开我，皮留在我手里。
lines.en: You throw me off, and skin stays in my hand.
I throw my whole body onto you.

lines.zh: 我的爪子从指节里顶出来。
lines.en: Claws push out of my knuckles.
You back to the wall, with nowhere left.

lines.zh: 这一击很轻，我还没用力。
lines.en: A light hit; I haven't used my strength.
One twist, and you go limp.
I let go only after you drop.
I grow out of the shadow.
Something new occupies the corner.
A drop falls from the ceiling.

lines.zh: 我先是形状，然后才像人。
lines.en: First I'm a shape, then I look like a person.
The air behind the door turns cold.
I straighten up, a little taller than you.
Something squeezes out of the wall seam.
I open my eyes and see the floor first.
No one noticed my arrival.

lines.zh: 我学着站起来，摔了一次。
lines.en: I try to stand, and fall once.
Fire! My skin is shrinking back.
I fall and splat flat.

lines.zh: 水灌进来，我整个人发胀。
lines.en: Water floods in and I swell all over.

lines.zh: 爆风把我的形状吹散了。
lines.en: The blast blows my shape apart.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎进来，带出一块。
lines.en: An arrow lodges in me and pulls a piece out.

lines.zh: 那股法术让我的肉发抖。
lines.en: That spell makes my flesh shudder.
I've gone too long hungry.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我全身都在跳。
lines.en: Lightning hits and my whole body jerks.
The void pulls me apart.
